label: EXPLORATORY_AND_CONFIRMATORY_SEPARATED

frozen_defaults.note: Do not retune Gate 1 or overwrite frozen v0.1.1 / A1 / cycle2 artifacts.

primary_question: Can additional information actually rescue a decision?
correctness: predicted_hypothesis_id == intent.correct_hypothesis (same as sanity benchmark). ASK still carries a predicted hypothesis.
confirmatory_dataset: sanity fixture 40 intents x {q0,q1,q2} = 120 queries under configs/poc.yaml
exploratory_datasets: optional rescue_probe queries (mechanism check, not confirmatory)
historical WDI A1 matched table if present (not re-fit)

splits.rule: Group by intent_id. All paraphrases (q0/q1/q2) of an intent stay in the same split.
splits.recoverability_development: first 28 intent_ids lexicographic (seed 42 shuffle of unique intent_id)

gates.cycle4: 100% included FastWrong classified; INDETERMINATE=0 on confirmatory included set; OracleRescueCeiling reported by domain and condition
gates.cycle5_mechanism: NonOracleRescueCount > 0 on confirmatory holdout-untouched queries, no gold in query construction
gates.cycle5_policy_ready: NetRescueRate > 0 AND DeltaU_EXPLORE > 0 with cluster-bootstrap 95% CI on confirmatory set
gates.cycle6: Delta NEU > 0 only if cycle5_policy_ready PASS; else BLOCKED

multiple_comparisons: Holm on confirmatory arm comparisons (full, disc_predicted, bm25-only) vs Fast; exploratory arms unadjusted and labeled EXPLORATORY
exclusions: Queries with missing intent.correct_hypothesis. INDETERMINATE rows fail Cycle 4 unless excluded under this plan (none pre-registered).
identification: Oracle interventions are controlled counterfactuals inside this system, not identified real-world causes. Do not sum attributions as a causal partition.
notes: Ground truth is isolated in oracle.* modules.
predicted_hypothesis mode never receives H*, intent label, or gold document ids.
Heuristic discrimination score is not exact EIG.
WDI A1 Rescue=0 is a preserved historical observation; this cycle's confirmatory fixture is the 120-query sanity set.
